name: DialogOverlayPrimitive
description: Semi-transparent backdrop rendered behind the dialog popup. Renders a `<div>` element.

props.name: className
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: forceRender
props.description: Whether the backdrop is forced to render even when nested.

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: Dialog.OverlayPrimitive.State) => ReactElement) | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
